description: Rank border crossings by the current wait for a lane type and name the fastest. Pass crossings (e.g. ["San Ysidro", "Otay Mesa", "Tecate"]) or near (an area or state, e.g. "San Diego", "Juarez", "Niagara", "TX"). Drive time to each port is not included.

lane.description: Lane type: car (general), sentri_nexus, ready_lane, pedestrian, pedestrian_ready, truck or truck_fast. Default car.

near.description: An area or state instead of a list.

name: border_fastest_crossing
title: Fastest border crossing
